$comment: Frozen inputs of the 0.19.0 ledger (hds#450), read by scripts/upgrade/build-ledger.mjs. 0.19.0 shipped before ledgers existed, so its record was written after the fact from the published tarball's snapshot (docs/api/releases/0.19.0.json) and its CHANGELOG section. Each CHANGELOG.md:<line> is numbered as the file read when 0.19.0 shipped (its section starts on line 3, and is byte-identical to the one at tag v0.19.0); its needle is the text that finds the line.
summary: Overlays portal into the nearest data-hds scope, compact density tightens spacing, containers share one radius; adds /icons.

steps.subject: overlay-portals
steps.plain: Dialog, AlertDialog, Menu, ContextMenu, Popover, Select, HoverCard, Tooltip, Lightbox and AssetImg's expand pill now mount inside the nearest data-hds element instead of document.body, so they take its theme, and CSS or tests that expect them under body may need updating.

steps.subject: modal-scrim
steps.plain: The scrim behind an open Dialog or AlertDialog is now the theme-aware scrim color, black in dark mode where it was a white wash.
steps.needle: The modal scrim uses the new theme-aware

steps.subject: dark-color-scheme
steps.plain: The dark theme now declares color-scheme: dark, so native scrollbars and form controls inside it render dark.
steps.needle: the dark theme now declares `color-scheme: dark`

steps.subject: compact-density
steps.plain: Under data-density="compact" the spacing scale, surface padding and region gutter that components read now tighten, so compact screens render visibly tighter than before.

steps.subject: Table-density-inherit
steps.plain: A Table with no density prop now follows the nearest data-density attribute, so a Table inside a compact region renders compact unless you pass density.

steps.subject: container-radius
steps.plain: Surface, StatusTile, DocLinkCard and static.css's .hds-card now round to the tenant's container radius, 12px by default, instead of a fixed 8px.
steps.needle: Containers now share one radius that follows the tenant knob

steps.subject: Button-iconOnly-warning
steps.plain: In development, a Button with iconOnly and no iconLeft now logs one warning, so a test that fails on console warnings will flag it.
steps.needle: In development, `<Button iconOnly>` with no `iconLeft` now warns once
